description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders GM Adam Peters called Chig Okonkwo a "really good receiver" but adds he's super tough as a blocker.
items.impact: "He provides a lot of versatility with where he can line up," Peters said. Okonkwo signed with Washington in free agency this offseason. He'll be an intriguing double-digit round target for fantasy managers this season at the tight end position.
items.title: Chig Okonkwo draws praise as both receiver and blocker from GM

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders Pro Bowl P Tress Way will be sidelined to start training camp with a pectoral injury.
items.impact: It is not considered a long-term injury for Way.
items.title: Tress Way (pec) to miss start of training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Marvin Harrison Jr. was dealing with cramps.
items.impact: Harrison had to stop practicing a couple times on Sunday. It is a positive sign it isn't a leg or hamstring injury he is dealing with.
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. dealing with cramps

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Denzel Ward has agreed to a 2-year, $62.2 million extension with the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Ward's new deal includes $52.3 million guaranteed and makes him the highest-paid defensive back in NFL history. The 29-year-old has been one of the best corners in the league throughout his career, including Pro Bowl appearances in each of the last three seasons.
items.title: Denzel Ward signs 2-year extension with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted QB Jack Plummer for a workout.
items.impact: Plummer was the UFL MVP this past spring. He previously worked out for the 49ers as well.
items.title: Jack Plummer works out for Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills placed WR Tyrell Shavers on the PUP list.
items.impact: Shavers is working his way back from a torn ACL he suffered in the playoffs last January.
items.title: Tyrell Shavers (knee) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kendre Miller has avoided the PUP list to begin Saints training camp.
items.impact: Miller has struggled to stay healthy to begin his NFL career. He will be competing for the RB3 role in the Saints backfield behind Travis Etienne and Alvin Kamara.
items.title: Kendre Miller (knee) avoids PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted RB Clyde Edwards-Helaire for a workout.
items.impact: Edwards-Helaire spent last season on the Chiefs practice squad. He'll look to earn an opportunity in Dolphins training camp.
items.title: Clyde Edwards-Helaire works out for Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers officially placed Micah Parsons on the PUP list.
items.impact: This was expected. It was a matter of it was going to happen on Tuesday or Wednesday. Parsons will miss the start of the season and is currently looking at a potential return around Week 6.
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) officially placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed M.J. Stewart Jr. on the PUP list.
items.impact: Stewart can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: M.J. Stewart Jr. placed on PUP list

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tank Dell has been cleared for the Texans training camp.
items.impact: This is great news for the talented young receiver. He tore multiple ligaments in his knee due to a freak accident where his teammate ran into him in 2024, his surgeries and recovery that followed caused him to miss all of 2025. But, it appears he is ready to go at it again in 2026. Hopefully he can have a breakout year after a promising start to his career.
items.title: Tank Dell cleared for Texans training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed E.J. Speed on the PUP list.
items.impact: Speed fully tore his quadriceps tendon back in June earlier in the Texans offseason program.
items.title: E.J. Speed (quad) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed WR Jaylin Noel on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Noel can be activated at any point during training camp. He will be competing for the starting role in the slot for Houston.
items.title: Jaylin Noel placed on non-football injury list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams placed OL Justin Dedich on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Dedich suffered a hand injury around the Fourth of July. He is competing for a depth role on the Rams offensive line.
items.title: Justin Dedich (hand) placed on non-football injury list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed OL Christian Mahogany on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Mahogany can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Christian Mahogany placed on non-football injury list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed DB Christian Izien on the non-football illness list.
items.impact: Izien can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Christian Izien placed on non-football illness list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions released DL Jay Tufele.
items.impact: Tufele signed with Detroit in April. He played in 12 games with the Jets last season. He'll seek another opportunity.
items.title: Jay Tufele released by Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed TE Thomas Yassmin.
items.impact: Yassmin will compete for a depth role in the tight end room for Green Bay.
items.title: Thomas Yassmin signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers released EDGE Dante Barnett.
items.impact: Barnett had been with Green Bay on a futures deal. He'll seek another opportunity.
items.title: Dante Barnett released by Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers released K Lucas Havrisik.
items.impact: Havrisik went 4-for-4 on field goal attempts in three games last season with Green Bay. He'll look to land another opportunity.
items.title: Lucas Havrisik released by Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed K Lenny Krieg.
items.impact: Krieg earns a spot in training camp with Green Bay. He will compete to be the starting kicker.
items.title: Lenny Krieg signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers signed LS Peter Bowden.
items.impact: Bowden will compete to be the starting long snapper for the Chargers.
items.title: Peter Bowden signs with Chargers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Joe Alt said he is unsure if he'll have any restrictions as camp starts Wednesday.
items.impact: Alt added that he feels 100 percent healthy. He could be eased back, but he remains well on track to be good to go for the start of the season.
items.title: Joe Alt (ankle) unsure if he'll face any restrictions in training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets placed EDGE Joseph Ossai on the PUP list.
items.impact: Ossai can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Joseph Ossai placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets activated Tim Patrick from the PUP list.
items.impact: Patrick opened training camp on the PUP list. He will return to practice this week.
items.title: Tim Patrick activated from PUP list

title: Fantasy Player News
